ROM Studio native cartridge, RXWS and DSi adapters

Format and hardware references for the cartridge, RXWS and DSi adapters.

Game Boy hardware: gbdev Pan Docs (CC0)
https://gbdev.io/pandocs/
RXWS format: vgmstream, pinned source revision
https://github.com/vgmstream/vgmstream/blob/6d8f68b505409399e790da888119c3f3fd6c721a/src/meta/rxws.c
The retained vgmstream ISC notice is in adx-NOTICE.txt.
DSi modcrypt algorithm and byte order references:
https://github.com/TuxSH/twlnandtool/blob/master/source/crypto/crypto_twl.hpp
https://github.com/TuxSH/twlnandtool/blob/master/source/crypto/crypto_twl_keyscrambler.hpp
https://github.com/WinterMute/twltool/blob/master/dsi.c
https://problemkaputt.de/gbatek-dsi-cartridge-header.htm
